name: MyIP
author: Shirak Semonian
description: Your public IP at a glance: shows the live public IPv4 with its country flag in the Omarchy bar, with a calm offline state and a details panel with location, ISP/AS, address history and copy. Quietly warns once when your public IP changes (VPN-leak alert). Quiet, configurable polling (default 60 s), no key, no account.
